//: globalDependencies lists the root config files that change what a task MEANS. Without them Turbo hashes package contents only, so tightening a lint rule leaves every package cached and the stricter rule never runs - the task reports success without executing. A green build that proves nothing is worse than a slow one. NOTE on build.outputs: src/tokens/** and src/styles/tokens/** are generated INTO ionbase-ui's source tree by its sync-tokens step, so they must be declared as outputs - otherwise a cache hit restores dist/ while leaving those stale, and the build compiles against last week's tokens. Turbo rejects comment keys inside tasks, which is why this note lives up here.
